findings.title: The layout does not adapt to narrow screens

location.description: the navigation links beside the logo, the plot card beside the headline, and the four feature cards, on the phone and tablet

findings.viewer_experience: On the phone the page scrolls sideways, the navigation runs into the logo, the plot card covers the end of the headline and leaves the screen, and the feature text runs one word per line. On the tablet the cards and plot cells are cramped.

current.value: page 497 px wide in a 390 px viewport; nav links 19 px tall; feature cards 4 to 6 characters per line on phone, 12 to 15 on tablet; plot cells 19 to 26 px wide on tablet

findings.target: no sideways scroll at 390 px; navigation links at least 24 px tall; plot card below the headline; feature cards 45 to 75 characters per line or stacked one or two per row; plot cells of equal width
findings.fix_direction: Stack the hero to one column (headline, text, button, then the plot card), collapse the navigation, and stack the feature cards one or two per row below the desktop width.

closed_when.check: page_width equals the viewport width in the phone viewport; violations is empty in the phone viewport; characters_per_line of div.cards > div.card > p in the phone and tablet viewports is 30 or more; div.plan-grid > div.plot boxes in the tablet viewport are of equal width

findings.title: Below the headline, every level of text looks the same

location.description: the section heading "What Plotwise does" and the four card titles, set like the card descriptions

findings.viewer_experience: The card title runs into its sentence like one line with a missing period, the reader cannot scan the four features by name, and the section heading looks like a caption.

current.value: 15 px, weight 400, #55604f on h2, div.card > h3, and div.card > p

findings.target: two to four text levels that differ at a glance, with the card titles and the section heading set apart from the descriptions
findings.fix_direction: Set the card titles heavier or in the darker #2f3a2c, and give the section heading a clear step up. No new sizes are needed.

closed_when.check: font_weight or color of div.card > h3 differs from div.card > p, and font_size or font_weight of h2 differs from div.card > h3, in all viewports

findings.title: On a wide screen the hero comes apart

location.description: the headline column pinned left and the plot card pinned right at 1920 px

findings.viewer_experience: The headline and the plot card read as two separate things with a wide empty band between them, and the feature cards stretch so their text sits on one line with empty space beside it.

current.value: about 850 px of empty band between the h1 (x 64 to 584) and div.plan-title (x 1457); feature cards 440 px wide

findings.target: the hero halves stay together and the content keeps its desktop layout at 1920 px
findings.fix_direction: Cap the content width, or let the hero's two halves stay together.

closed_when.check: the gap between the right edge of h1 and the left edge of div.plan-title in the widescreen viewport is about as small as in the desktop viewport (about 233 px)

findings.title: The plot map does not show the waiting list the copy promises

location.description: the plot card title and map

findings.viewer_experience: The card shows which plots are free and which are taken, but not the free plot going to the next person on the list.

current.value: card title "Elm Row Gardens, plots 1 to 12" names the garden and does not say what to notice

findings.target: the card shows the step the copy describes, a free plot going to whoever is next on the list
findings.fix_direction: Let the card show that step. The names and data it needs are only the maker's to supply.

closed_when.check: a fresh critic sees the plot card show a free plot offered to the next person on the list

findings.title: The rent reminder line can be read two ways

location.description: the description of the Rent reminders card

findings.viewer_experience: "Each grower gets one reminder before rent is due in March" can mean rent is always due in March, or only in this example, and "one reminder" can read as a hard limit. A garden with another month may decide Plotwise does not fit.

current.value: "Each grower gets one reminder before rent is due in March."

findings.target: a line that says whether the month and the number of reminders can change
findings.fix_direction: If the month and the number of reminders can change, say so in the line. Only the maker knows whether they can.

closed_when.check: a fresh critic reads the Rent reminders line and sees it say the month and the number of reminders can change, or that they are fixed

findings.title: The taken swatch and taken plots almost disappear on the white card

location.description: the "Taken" swatch in the key and the taken plots

findings.viewer_experience: The key's second entry barely registers.

current.value: #e4e8df on white, by eye well under 3:1 (not measured in the facts file)

findings.target: non-text contrast of at least 3:1 for the taken fill against the card
findings.fix_direction: Darken the taken fill or give it an outline.

closed_when.check: a fresh critic sees the Taken swatch and the taken plots clearly set off from the white card in all viewports

findings.title: "yes." sits alone on the last line of the Plot offers card

location.description: the description of the Plot offers card

findings.viewer_experience: The paragraph ends on one short word.

current.value: last line is the single word "yes."

findings.target: a last line that is not a single short word
findings.fix_direction: Adjust the width or the wording so the line does not end on a single short word.

closed_when.check: a fresh critic sees the last line of the Plot offers description hold more than one word in the desktop and tablet viewports

findings.title: The page ends after the feature row with no footer and no second button

location.description: the end of the page below the feature cards

findings.viewer_experience: A reader convinced by the features has to scroll back up to act.

current.value: no footer and no second "Add your garden" button after the feature row

findings.target: a way to act at the end of the page
findings.fix_direction: Add a second "Add your garden" button and a footer after the feature row.

closed_when.check: a fresh critic sees an "Add your garden" button and a footer below the feature cards
